description: State Highway System Intersection is a dataset listed in Caltrans GIS Data hub, an open geospatial data hub of a state transportation department, published or maintained by Caltrans. As part of the Transportation System Network Replacement Project (TSNR), Highway Inventory module data migration, it was determined Caltrans would be utilizing Rizing’s Intersection Manager (IM) product to create and manage intersection data. Coverage: California, United States. The hub lists this as a dataset of Caltrans. Its keywords are Transportation, Postmiles, Intersections, State Highway Network, State Highway System, Division of Research Innovation and System Information, Caltrans, California Department of Transportation. The bounding box given is -124.2639,32.5644,-114.3009,42.0013. The hub shows 2026-04-06 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open.
